# Story 9.2: Standardize table date format to MM/DD/YYYY

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want every date column in the tables to be formatted as `MM/DD/YYYY`,
So that dates are consistent across all screens and not dependent on the browser/system locale.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The shared default-cell date case in `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.html` (line 150) changes from `date: 'shortDate'` to `date: 'MM/dd/yyyy'`, so any table that uses the default cell renderer (Sold Positions Buy Date / Sell Date) renders `MM/DD/YYYY`.
2. The open-positions custom `#cellTemplate` date case in `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/open-positions.component.html` changes from `date : 'shortDate'` to `date: 'MM/dd/yyyy'`, so Open Positions Ex-Date / Buy Date / Sell Date render `MM/DD/YYYY`.
3. No other table date rendering is changed — dividend-deposits and global-universe already use `'MM/dd/yyyy'` and remain untouched; non-table surfaces (auth profile cards using `date: 'medium'`) are out of scope.
4. Story 9.1's red-phase unit assertions are unskipped and green under `nx test dms-material`, with no pre-existing regression.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1: Remove `.skip()` markers from Story 9.1's tests and confirm they fail (red)
  - [x] 1.1 Un-skip every `it.skip` added by Story 9.1 in the base-table and open-positions specs.
  - [x] 1.2 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm the new assertions FAIL while `'shortDate'` is still in place.
- [x] Task 2: Fix the shared default-cell date format (AC: #1)
  - [x] 2.1 In `base-table.component.html`, change the `#defaultCell` `@case ('date')` from `{{ row[column.field] | date: 'shortDate' }}` to `{{ row[column.field] | date: 'MM/dd/yyyy' }}`.
- [x] Task 3: Fix the open-positions custom template date format (AC: #2)
  - [x] 3.1 In `open-positions.component.html`, change the custom `#cellTemplate` `@case ('date')` from `{{ row[column.field] | date : 'shortDate' }}` to `{{ row[column.field] | date: 'MM/dd/yyyy' }}`.
- [ ] Task 4: Verify green + no regression (AC: #3, #4)
  - [ ] 4.1 Re-run `nx test dms-material`; confirm Story 9.1's assertions pass and no pre-existing spec regresses.
  - [ ] 4.2 Run `nx run dms-material:lint` and the build target; both clean.

## Dev Notes

- Red-phase TDD convention: this story's FIRST task is to remove Story 9.1's `.skip()` markers, confirm red, then implement until green.
- **Exactly two sites change.** Verified on disk that these are the only table date renderings still using `'shortDate'`:
  - `base-table.component.html:150` (shared default cell → Sold Positions Buy Date / Sell Date; sold-positions passes no custom template).
  - `open-positions.component.html` custom `#cellTemplate` date case (Ex-Date / Buy Date / Sell Date).
- **Do NOT touch:** dividend-deposits (`date : 'MM/dd/yyyy'`) and global-universe (`most_recent_sell_date | date : 'MM/dd/yyyy'`) — already correct. The auth profile cards use `date: 'medium'` (a non-table surface) and are explicitly out of scope for this Epic, which is about *tables*.
- **Why `'MM/dd/yyyy'`:** the Epic prose requires "consistently formatted as MM/DD/YYYY." An explicit format string removes locale dependence entirely; `shortDate` under en-US yields `M/d/yy`, which fails the requirement.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.html` (one pipe argument).
- Modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/open-positions.component.html` (one pipe argument).
- No conflict: two one-token changes; no structural or behavioral change beyond the date string format.
